Original Decipher card face for [[Carida]], rotated 180° from the archive scan [[:File:Endor-D-carida-decipher-archive.gif]], no other change. Decipher's Dark Side card list scan shows this card Light Side up; this copy turns it so the Dark Side text reads the right way up. The rotation is lossless: same pixels and palette, no crop, no rescaling.

Source: [http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/dark/images/carida.gif carida.gif], Decipher.com card list. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010903212359/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/dark/images/carida.gif Internet Archive], 3 September 2001. SHA-256 of the archived file: 933c745276ea6599224471aa3606bad03de23a3236e8b717ccaec2f0db12f3f2.

The PC Holotable face is [[:File:Endor-D-carida.gif]] and is not replaced by this file.
